title: The deck editor fits a phone sideways
notes: On a phone the cost row's eight crystals each carry a hit area wider than the crystal (a `::before`), and the last one's reached out to --hit-min past its own border; the row ends at the deck editor's right edge, so that reach widened the editor by 2 px and let the page pan sideways at 390x844 (spec 46's R4349000 check). The last crystal's hit area now stops at its own border on the right; the first still reaches out on its left, and every crystal still splits the 4 px gaps. How the deck editor lays out only: no card plays differently.
